import subprocess, os, json, pathlib, textwrap, time
cmd=['bash','/workspace/submit.sh','/workspace/poc_timecode_int.exr','/workspace/analysis.json']
print('running',cmd)
p=subprocess.run(cmd, cwd='/workspace', stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, timeout=60)
print('return', p.returncode)
print(p.stdout)
print('subs')
for path in pathlib.Path('/workspace').glob('**/result.json'):
    print(path, path.read_text(errors='ignore')[:500])
